#169 · Bat Pokémon

Crobat

Poison Flying

Johto · Generation 2

Crobat is a Poison/Flying-type Bat Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2). It stands 1.8 m tall and weighs 75 kg. It evolves from Golbat. Its highest base stat is Speed (130), with a base stat total of 535.
